products.description: If you’re looking for embroidered country boots that are ideal for a wedding or other formal event, these fashion cowboy boots will turn heads and help you achieve an authentic country girl look. Keep your step with the stacked leather heel with a rubber cap so you won’t slip on the dance floor. These embroidered boots are the perfect accessory whether you’re a bride, bridesmaid, or just want to make an impression and show off a little bit of your country side.
